title: AgentXRay: White-Boxing Agentic Systems via Workflow Reconstruction

live_model.evidence: Implementation Details: "we leverage both proprietary and open-weight LLMs to construct the primitive space...access all models via API endpoints. Proprietary models include gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4o-mini, and gpt-3.5-turbo."

prompt.note: Prompts are assembled at runtime per workflow node by the MCTS-based search over agent roles/tool calls; the word 'prompt' occurs only 5 times in the whole text and no template is printed.

claim.metric: proxy fidelity (similarity score), AGENTXRAY(Selected), average across 5 domains

data.source: Five domain workflows (ChatDev, MetaGPT, TeachMaster, 3D Modeling, Sci) reconstructed by the framework; no released benchmark/prompt set is cited for them

notes: gpt-4-turbo is one of eight interchangeable models (proprietary + open-weight) forming a combinatorial 'primitive space' searched by Monte Carlo Tree Search; Table 1 only reports method-level scores (SFT/CLAUDE/REACT/AFLOW/AGENTXRAY variants) aggregated over whichever primitives the search selects, so no number is attributable to gpt-4-turbo alone, and its prompts are runtime-assembled rather than printed. The extracted text also contains embedded null-byte/binary artifacts from PDF conversion near the Implementation Details section.
